Every year we offer a selection of Scholarships to support gifted and talented individuals with their study aims. Whether this is your first degree, you are looking to retrain or upskill to develop your knowledge or skills our Scholarships are designed to appeal a variety of prospective students from a variety of backgrounds with a wide range of career and academic aims.

Scholarships Available to Medical School Students

The Eira Francis Davies Scholarship

The Eira Francis Davies Scholarship is a full tuition fee scholarship ordinarily awarded to one outstanding female student per academic year. The student must be a national of and resident in an eligible developing country, who pursues a postgraduate taught Master’s programme within Swansea University’s Faculty of Health and Life Sciences.
